cues.text: Dear all, Greetings from the Office of the Official Narrator. This is to inform you that the Official Campus Comic has run for four thousand pages without a single twist, with the continuous support of the institute. Freshers are reminded of the 11 PM induction curfew. Nobody will follow it. P.S. The TAs of this comic (me) requested a salary hike. Management has replied: no. That's fine. I'm fine. What could possibly go wrong? Regards. Bonda!
